limitations: Three provider-specific price gaps; separate owner XLS observations do not turn them into CafeF bars. Historical corporate-action/PIT continuity unqualified.
Downloaded event inventory is tab1 only, 35 events over 2 pages. Treasury transactions, cancellations, all issuer announcements and all effective-date registers are not exhaustively covered.

The retained 2026 document listing has 17 rows; it is a provider snapshot, not a complete all-channel disclosure inventory. Some listed report/explanatory/AGM documents were not downloaded; their contents were not reviewed. No share-action document was identified by their titles. Title review alone does not prove absence of action content.

Older financial-report notes and historical event metadata were reused. This run visually reviewed Q3 physical pages59,67,68–72 and the one-page Oct30 cash notice, not every page of every retained PDF. Unreviewed content is not a complete negative search.

Q3 is the owner-selected reference for retrospective research: statement signed30Oct, provider listing updated31Oct01:29:53.860Z and PDF retrieved2Nov. No proof of availability before the30Oct trading cutoff; no PIT/backtest or formal source admission is granted.
No independently verified October issued/treasury flow register or zero-transaction certificate exists. Carry-forward is the approved documentary rule, not verified unchanged shares on every day.
